lede: Cincinnati carries the stronger underlying team rating — +1.3 against -0.6, a 1.9-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Arizona -8.4 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Arizona winning 71% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 84% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
